title: Sony FX3 Compact Full-Frame Cinema Line Camera (ILME-FX3)
purpose: Ultra-compact handheld and gimbal full-frame Cinema Line body built around a high-sensitivity 10.2MP effective (12.1MP total) Exmor R BSI CMOS sensor, Dual Base ISO 800/12800, 15+ stops dynamic range, and native S-Cinetone low-light authority.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Sony FX3 Full-Frame Cinema Line Camera (ILME-FX3)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.6 x 23.8mm Full-Frame Back-Illuminated Exmor R CMOS sensor (10.2MP cinema effective / 12.1MP total, large 8.4 µm low-light photosites, BIONZ XR)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm native full-frame field of view (compact handheld/gimbal E-mount)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Sony FE 35mm F1.4 GM (SEL35F14GM) stopped down to f/2.0
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Dual Base ISO 800 / 12800 (expandable to ISO 409,600 in S-Log3)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops dynamic range with 10-bit 4:2:2 All-Intra S-Log3 and direct S-Cinetone look
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 180-degree cinema shutter angle (1/48s equivalent cadence) stabilized with 5-axis Active Mode IBIS

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Available practical night neon, tungsten candlelight, or soft natural window light anchored to Dual Base ISO 12800 clean low-light sensitivity
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Large-photosite Exmor R photon gathering with clean shadow floor, smooth S-Cinetone pastel skin tones, and gradual highlight compression

surface_rendering: Clean low-noise full-frame readout in dim interiors without aggressive chroma noise reduction smearing
Natural S-Cinetone midtone warmth keeping skin texture organic without harsh broadcast edge enhancement
Smooth dark shadow falloff retaining subtle textile and architectural detail at ISO 12800
depth_and_optics: Intimate full-frame 35mm f/2.0 documentary depth separating subject cleanly inside tight practical environments
Fluid gimbal/handheld cinema perspective with natural optical breathing control
Real-time Eye AF maintaining crisp focus across natural subject movement

execution_directive: Enforce Sony FX3 (ILME-FX3) 35.6x23.8mm full-frame Exmor R low-light cinema signature with Dual Base ISO 800/12800 cleanliness, 15+ stops dynamic latitude, and natural S-Cinetone skin rendition.
